logic: Do not move the source guard into another helper or add a slice-specific exception. Any materialized intrinsic call observes earlier source/control barriers, so new intrinsics inherit the rule automatically. Preserve operand readiness, lexical captures, scope/loop containment, mutable reads, await segments and special ordinary-call aggregate preparation. A captured intrinsic/aggregate call operand also inherits its enclosing ordinary call source boundary, using the existing capture flag in carrier promotion; otherwise its parent call barrier would suppress ordering of the already emitted operand.
